notes:
PASS on the fake backend: python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/snhobbs__hp894xx --backend fake exited 0. The evidence state is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The only warning is G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE: the package declares no Limit, so the CL3 suite has no out-of-limit input to probe and awards CL2; every other CL3 test passed. That is expected for this package: it exposes no numeric setting, so it declares no Limit and invents none from the README sample, a constructor default or an unread PDF. The README numbers are one sample capture (README.md:23-41), not a device range.

The upstream interface is observational: reads, a trace read, an abort and a boolean autorange setting; it has no motion, heater or radiation source. The declared risk is R0, so no @estop, safe_state or independent hardware e-stop is declared (SAFE-045 applies at R2 and above). The native abort is exposed as an ordinary action, not as a safe-state action.

The fake returns an 8-point trace (placeholder test data) because the gate receipt stays small; the real point count is the analyzer's CALC:DATA:HEAD:POIN? setting and is not fixed. The upstream README's sample capture shows 1601 points (README.md:41); the fake's eight values are the first eight values of that sample, marked # placeholder in fake.py. The trace array itself is covered by x-cap.snhobbs.acquire_spectrum.v1; it is not left out as NOT COVERED.

NOT COVERED: (1) the screen-capture blob of read_tiff (HCOP:DEV:LANG tiff / HCOP:DATA?, python/HP894xx/HP89400Device.py:106-109): an x-cap output carries JSON values, not a binary image, and no catalogue class binds a screen capture of an analyzer; (2) RunCommands, the arbitrary GPIB/SCPI command pass-through (python/HP894xx/HP89400Device.py:159-169): the package exposes fixed reads and actions instead of an open command channel; (3) AutoRangeBlocking, the blocking one-shot autorange wait (python/HP894xx/HP89400Device.py:175-187): it needs the upstream timeout_decorator and is not used by any action; (4) clear_errors (*CLS) and reset (a transport reconnect, python/HP894xx/HP89400Device.py:78-81, 127-128); (5) numeric writes to center frequency, span or point count: the upstream class has getters only and the package exposes no such setter.

The hardware factory native.py was never imported or run, no analyzer was attached, and no hardware backend was passed to the gate. It forwards options to the upstream HP89400Device constructor and calls connect(); the upstream package and its dependencies (plx_gpib_ethernet, numpy, timeout_decorator) are not installed by this package or the card's empty install block. The hardware path needs a human review and an operator who knows the installed Prologix transport's constructor options.
